name: MedCalc-Bench
intro: MedCalc-Bench是面向大型语言模型医学计算能力的基准，包含55个MDCalc任务的1,047条人工复核样本，其中19个为规则型计算器、36个为公式型计算器。每条样本含患者病历、计算问题、相关属性、标准答案和逐步解释，用于同时检验医学知识、属性抽取和算术计算。
build_method: 混合, LLM生成, 专家构建
task_type: 开放式问答, 数学问题, 抽取
intro_en: MedCalc-Bench evaluates LLM medical-calculation ability with 1,047 manually reviewed instances from 55 MDCalc tasks: 19 rule-based and 36 equation-based calculators. Each item contains a patient note, a calculation question, relevant attributes, a gold answer, and a step-by-step explanation, jointly testing medical knowledge, attribute extraction, and arithmetic.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.12036 and the official ncbi-nlp/MedCalc-Bench repository. The diagrams preserve selection of 55 MDCalc tasks split into 19 rule-based and 36 equation-based calculators and seven subtypes; the more-than-180,000-note Open-Patients pool; GPT-3.5-Turbo eligibility detection; GPT-4 attribute extraction; medical-professional verification covering 34 calculators; completion of the remaining 21 calculators with 20 notes each through templates for ten equation tasks and clinician-written notes for eleven rule tasks; calculator templates for step-by-step gold solutions; the exact 1,047-instance test set; eight-model evaluation under zero-shot direct, zero-shot CoT, and same-calculator one-shot CoT; exact matching for rule and date tasks, 5% tolerance for laboratory, physical, and dosage calculations; seven-subtype Accuracy; and knowledge, extraction, computation, and other error analysis.
